_comment: The price table of the service: what a model call costs, in USD per million tokens, per API model id. The console computes the cost signal from it, and the question runner computes the cost of a configuration from it. A model not listed here is counted at 0 and reported as unpriced. A cache write costs `cacheWriteFactor` (1.25) times the input price (5-minute cache); a cache read costs `cacheReadFactor` (0.1) times it.
